def transform(grid):
    """Reflect the source tile across each of its four edges to make a 3x3 mirror tiling."""
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        src_rows = list(range(n)) if tile_r == 1 else (list(range(n - 1, -1, -1)) if tile_r == 0 else list(range(n - 1, -1, -1)))
        for r in src_rows:
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(3):
                src_cols = list(range(m)) if tile_c == 1 else list(range(m - 1, -1, -1))
                row.extend(grid[r][c] for c in src_cols)
            out.append(row)
    return out
PY
